dct_description_sm: To measure the loading of current use and legacy pesticides to melt ponds with surface snow melt and with air-water gas exchange later in the summer. Further, to compare it to standing stocks in the surface seawater when drainage takes place later in the summer season.
dct_subject_sm: Health sciences and contaminants -> Legacy pesticide
Health sciences and contaminants -> Current use pesticide
Health sciences and contaminants -> Persistent organic pollutants (POPs)
dct_title_s: Current use and legacy pesticides in Resolute Bay
